job.title: LSTM Code for Environmental Prediction
job.description: I need assistance with developing a Python LSTM code to analyze Cuba datasets. My goal is to predict future environmental trends using an adjacency matrix with 40 nodes. The project involves working with specific environmental factors beyond the typical categories like temperature changes, pollution levels, and climate patterns.
requirements: Develop and implement LSTM code in Python
Utilize Cuba datasets with a 40-node adjacency matrix
Focus on predicting future environmental trends
ideal_skills_experience: Proficiency in Python and LSTM models
Ability to work with adjacency matrices and large datasets

proposal.text:
Hello ,

I'm excited about the opportunity to help you build an LSTM-based Python solution for predicting environmental trends using Cuba datasets and a 40-node adjacency matrix. Your project sounds fascinating, and I believe my hands-on experience aligns perfectly with what you're looking for.

Why I’d be a great fit:

LSTM from the ground up: I’ve implemented LSTM architectures from scratch, including a stock price predictor that I fine-tuned for precision and stability.

Environmental data at center stage: Built a crop recommendation system for the UNEP hackathon using complex environmental variables—not just basics like temperature or pollution.

Graph insights via adjacency: I’m comfortable working with adjacency matrices and graph-like data structures, and I can adapt them seamlessly into your forecasting model.

Ultimately, my goal is to deliver a solution that works and empowers you to understand, interpret, and extend as your data or objectives evolve.

Feel free to review my previous LSTM work here:
Full Link: https://github.com/Adieltheanalyst/LSTM-Forecasting

I’d be happy to chat about your data formats, key targets, or any specific environmental factors you want to prioritize before starting.

Looking forward to collaborating and delivering a tool you can rely on.

Best regards,
Adiel Ngugi
